dashboard_period: Since launch · dashboard view: Last 1 Year

kpi_note.title: A focused early read
kpi_note.text: Direct booking went live on 28 July. Booking and booking-revenue figures therefore reflect the first four days of the new experience; calls handled and time saved reflect the broader service period shown in the dashboard.

highlights.title: The new booking workflow was used successfully on day one
highlights.summary: On the first day of direct booking, a caller requested a same-day 2:42 PM tee time for two players. SpeakSport surfaced the available choices, secured the requested time and confirmed the 18-hole reservation with carts.
highlights.quote: “You’ve got it—two players today at 2:42 PM, eighteen holes at Gypsum Creek Golf Course with carts.”

highlights.title: An exact four-player request was booked without a handoff
highlights.summary: A caller asked for 1:42 PM the following day for four players and 18 holes. SpeakSport verified availability at the requested time, captured the reservation details and confirmed the booking with carts included.
highlights.quote: “I have a tee time available tomorrow … at 1:42 PM for four players playing eighteen holes.” The reservation was then confirmed during the call.

highlights.title: A near-time alternative became a confirmed group booking
highlights.summary: When a four-player group asked for 3:00 PM on Saturday, SpeakSport gave nearby nine-hole options. The caller selected 3:06 PM, and the tee time was confirmed with carts included.
highlights.quote: “I found a few options close to 3:00 PM … 2:18 PM, 3:06 PM, 3:18 PM, and 3:30 PM.”

features_intro: We have continued strengthening the integrated experience around booking accuracy, reservation servicing and clearer operational insight.

features.title: Cancellations on the call
features.description: Golfers can now cancel eligible bookings directly with SpeakSport, reducing avoidable transfers and making it easier to release tee times promptly.

features.title: Stronger booking-eligibility verification
features.description: Booking windows, customer context and other applicable booking rules are checked before a reservation is created.

features.title: Upcoming-booking confirmations
features.description: When golfers ask about an upcoming reservation, SpeakSport can retrieve and confirm the booking details during the call.

features.title: Richer back-office reporting
features.description: The dashboard now supports filtering calls by intent, category and outcome, making performance patterns and operational opportunities easier to find.

future_note: We will continue enriching SpeakSport with capabilities such as self-serve knowledge-base updates and even better reporting. We would love Gypsum Creek to remain part of that journey—please keep sharing feedback, ideas and initiatives you would like us to explore.

future_priorities.title: Self-serve knowledge base
future_priorities.description: Make it easier for your team to keep rates, policies, facility information and caller guidance current.

future_priorities.title: Even better reporting
future_priorities.description: Add clearer views of booking demand, eligibility, preferred playing times and caller outcomes.
